model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Uncensored GGUF Q4_K_M 7B
model.description: Uncensored DiT GGUF Q4_K_M (4.6 GB) from abenzerps, converted from Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 with no safety checker. Same 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL-8B encoder as the official stack (preload_URLs). Author's recommended quant. Mature Mode only. License follows Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Try this first among the uncensored GGUFs. Same t2i+edit tools as the other 2.1 models. Needs Mature Mode. INT8 ConvRot remains the SFW 4090 default.

resource_requirements.note: Recommended uncensored quant. Q8_0 from this pack has a known shape mismatch; not shipped.
